sourceBody: Loneliness can persuade you that withdrawing is safer than reaching out. Psalm 68:6 reminds us that God cares about belonging and community. Send one message, accept one invitation, or tell one trusted person how you are really doing. Connection often begins with a very small opening.
concept: At early evening, one adult opens an apartment door while a trusted friend waits patiently outside, making a small, genuine opening for connection.
